summary.text: Bob Marshall, listed by Ballotpedia as Robert Marshall, is a Democratic member of the Colorado House of Representatives from District 43 who took office on January 9, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a U.S. Marine Corps veteran and attorney.

paragraphs.text: Bob Marshall was born in and lives in Colorado and served in the U.S. Marine Corps.

He earned a bachelor's degree from Georgetown University, a J.D. and LL.M. in international law from Cornell Law School, where he graduated magna cum laude, and an LL.M. in tax law from the University of San Diego Law School.

His career experience includes working as an attorney for the Marine Corps, including at an air station in Iwakuni, Japan, and in Helmand Province, Afghanistan, and as a law clerk to Judge Eugene Siler, Jr., of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit.
He also worked as a commercial litigation and appellate specialist for a law firm in Colorado and in the large business and international litigation division of the Internal Revenue Service.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Marshall said he won House District 43 in 2022 as the first Democrat elected to a partisan office in Douglas County in more than 50 years.
He was unopposed in the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Nate Marsh in the general election.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the House Business Affairs and Labor Committee and the House Finance Committee.
In the survey, he listed good governance, public safety and the environment as his campaign messages and said he sponsored a law treating all auto theft as a felony.
